title: Classic Moroccan Lamb Tagine
description: A traditional Moroccan dish made with tender lamb and aromatic spices, slow-cooked in a clay pot.

ingredients.name: Spices
ingredients.notes: A mixture of cumin, coriander, cinnamon, turmeric, ginger, and black pepper

instructions: Heat oil in a large clay pot over medium heat.
Add the lamb and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the spices, olives, coriander, and preserved lemon.
Stir to combine, then add 1 cup of water.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2 hours.
Check the lamb for tenderness, then serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs.
